rationale: FAMILY SUBSTITUTION: this slot is a Claude substitute for the codex R5 seat (codex capacity-degraded); lens executed as assigned (schema/correctness). Reviewed commit 7b6d83f1 in the bead worktree; new tests run and pass individually and `go test ./... -short` is green from the worktree; worktree left byte-identical (verified via git status + git diff against 7b6d83f1). Lens items verified: (1) ADR-0035 refusal shape — stateDiscoveryFailure routes through guard.NewFailure, whose FormatFailure contract guarantees the final line is `recovery: mindspec doctor`; `doctor` is a registered cobra command (cmd/mindspec/doctor.go:15); the AC-1(ii) test asserts the recovery line and non-zero exit follows cobra convention (main.go otelExitCode default 1). Conforms. (2) BranchExistsIn is worktree-correct — `git rev-parse --verify --quiet refs/heads/<name>` (internal/gitutil/gitops.go:121-134) reads repo-shared refs, so a spec/<id> branch checked out in another worktree IS seen, and exit-1 (absent) is distinguished from real git failures, which propagate. (3) ErrAmbiguousTarget multi-draft rendering — verified by hand-probe with a built binary + fake bd in /tmp: two drafts render the full-ID listing with '(mode: spec)' per row, exit 1, and the advice is actionable because `--spec <full-draft-id>` passes through ResolveSpecPrefixWithCache validated (no epic needed) and the success path's draft-aware ResolveModeWithCache renders {"mode":"spec",...}. (4) ADR-0023 amendment text tracks the plan's OQ-2 'Chosen' paragraph nearly verbatim, is genuinely narrow (scopes only the single-authority sentence to post-approval lifecycle, only for pre-epic draft discovery, plus the R1.4 failure-propagation sentence), and leaves the :107/:108 strike (bead 4's) untouched. Also verified: draftSpecStatusWithCache's apparent error-swallow on its final FindEpicBySpecIDWithCache call is safe by construction — the up-front c.AllEpics() health probe memoizes success in the same cache, so the only error the later lookup can produce is the 'no epic found' no-match sentinel, which IS the draft condition. HOWEVER, the rewritten state.go fallback has a confirmed honesty defect (finding F1): an explicit --spec that fails resolution is silently swallowed and answered with AMBIENT state, exit 0 — including printing a DIFFERENT spec's identity. Empirically reproduced three ways from a /tmp fixture with healthy fake bd: (a) single draft 041-alpha-draft + `state show --spec 999` → {"mode":"spec","activeSpec":"041-alpha-draft"} exit 0 — an explicit query for spec 999 answered with spec 041's state; (b) same with an INVALID id `--spec 'bogus..name'` → same wrong-spec success, silently discarding the R3 explicit-ingress refusal ResolveSpecPrefixWithCache deliberately produced; (c) zero drafts + `--spec 999` → {"mode":"idle"} exit 0. The wrong-spec-attribution shape (a)/(b) is NEW behavior introduced by this bead's draft fallback (the pre-bead code's flag-swallow rendered ambient idle, not another spec's identity), and misattributing state to an explicit target is exactly the defect family this spec exists to remove. Fix is one guard: when specFlag is non-empty and resolution failed (non-ErrAmbiguousTarget), return resolveErr instead of entering the ambient draft/idle fallback.
concrete_changes_required: state.go stateShowCmd fallback: when the user passed an explicit --spec and resolve.ResolveTargetWithCache failed with anything other than *resolve.ErrAmbiguousTarget, propagate that resolution error (non-zero) instead of falling through to the ambient draft/idle discovery — an explicit target query must never be answered with a different spec's draft state ({"mode":"spec","activeSpec":"<other>"} exit 0, reproduced) or ambient idle (exit 0, reproduced). Add a regression test for the single-draft + nonexistent --spec case (red on the current tree).

Add the missing multi-draft leg: a state.go-level test asserting two drafts (no --spec) return *resolve.ErrAmbiguousTarget listing both with mode spec, and/or a DiscoverDraftSpecsWithCache multi-draft unit pinning the sorted two-element result — the BRIEF-claimed ambiguity behavior is delivered (verified only by my hand-probe) but currently untested at either layer.

findings.summary: Explicit --spec resolution failure silently swallowed by the rewritten fallback: `state show --spec 999` with one unrelated draft prints the OTHER spec's identity as {"mode":"spec","activeSpec":"041-alpha-draft"} exit 0 (also with an invalid --spec value, discarding the R3 ingress refusal); with zero drafts it prints {"mode":"idle"} exit 0. Reproduced empirically with healthy fake bd. The wrong-spec-attribution shape is new in this bead; state misattribution to an explicit query is the spec's target defect class. Not a hard_block: bd was healthy — this is a target-resolution swallow, not fabrication from a failed read.

No test exercises the multi-draft path at either layer (DiscoverDraftSpecsWithCache returns >1; state.go's ErrAmbiguousTarget branch). Hand-probe confirms correct behavior (full-ID listing, '(mode: spec)', exit 1), but the delivered branch is unpinned.

Judgment call A: ACCEPT on the merits. R1.2's letter targets state.go's composition and offers 'removed or asserted-consistent' — the implementation REMOVES ResolveContextFromDir from state.go and sources mode+activeBead from one cache-coherent chain (ResolveModeWithCache + FindEpicBySpecIDWithCache + FindActiveBeadForEpicWithCache on one phase.Cache). The implementer's regression argument checks out in code: ResolveTargetWithCache skips worktree-context derivation on WorktreeMain and ResolveContextFromDirWithCache derives purely from CWD, so the plan-literal substitution (context result as mode) would break `state show --spec <one-of-several>`. The surviving second derivation (instruct tails) is bead 5's assigned territory per the plan's own sequencing — a disagreement window bead 5 must close, not a contradiction now.

Remaining lens items all conform: ADR-0035 refusal shape (guard.NewFailure guarantees final 'recovery: mindspec doctor' line; doctor command exists; non-zero exit; no raw bd stderr enters the message — ListJSON errors carry exec-level text only); BranchExistsIn worktree-correct (repo-shared refs/heads via rev-parse, exit-1 vs real-error distinguished); ADR-0023 amendment narrow and faithful to plan OQ-2 (bead 4's :107/:108 strike untouched); draftSpecStatusWithCache's final FindEpic error-swallow safe by construction (memoized AllEpics health probe); composition-allowlist entries house-pattern with accurate Count 1 each; half-created draft (dir without branch) → idle is conformant with the amendment's both-exist definition; full -short suite green from the bead worktree, left byte-identical.
